units.source_text: 有一天，我依舊以悽慘的筆調，描寫了母親帶著我去東京途中的丟人經歷。

en.t: One day, in my usual miserable style, I wrote about the embarrassing experience of my mother taking me to Tokyo.

units.source_text: 途中，我把火車內通道上的痰盂當成了尿壺，把尿撒在了裡面

en.t: On the way, I mistook the spittoon in the train corridor for a chamber pot and urinated into it.

units.source_text: （其實，在去東京時，我並不是不知道那是痰盂，

en.t: Actually, when I went to Tokyo, it was not that I did not know it was a spittoon,

units.source_text: 而是為了炫耀孩子的天真無邪，才故意這麼寫的）。

en.t: but I deliberately wrote it that way in order to show off a child's innocent naivete.

units.source_text: 交了作文後，我深信老師看了肯定會發笑，於是就悄悄跟在走向辦公室的老師身後。

en.t: After handing in the composition, I was convinced the teacher would laugh when he read it, so I quietly followed him as he headed toward the office.

units.source_text: 只見老師一出教室，就從班上同學的一摞作文中挑出我的，

en.t: As soon as the teacher left the classroom, he picked mine out from the stack of my classmates' compositions,

units.source_text: 開始在走廊上邊走邊看，還不時發出嗤嗤的笑聲。

en.t: and began reading it as he walked down the corridor, letting out little chuckles now and then.
